summary: Wrong kind of design: the LCD is flat (0 degrees, not 30), the lid is a flat horizontal plate with no sloped face and no window, the Pico 2 was never placed (layout.unplaced) so there are no Pico standoffs and no USB opening in the back wall, and there are 4 closure bosses instead of 2. Gates G2, G4 and G5 fail.

defects.where: layout.json references[board lcd1602_hd44780] x0 y0 z0 rot_z 0, no tilt; renders views/ghost_left.png, ghost_iso.png
defects.what: LCD is laid flat: PCB Z 0..1.6, bezel face Z 13.0, VIEW_AXIS = (0,0,1).

defects.where: lid.stl outer face Z = 18.1, X -5.23..85.23, Y -5.23..41.23, normal (0,0,1) area 3653.8 mm2; views/model_iso.png
defects.what: Panel outer face is horizontal; the only face normals in lid.stl are +-X, +-Y, +-Z (no sloped face).
defects.expected: outer-face normal within 1.0 deg of VIEW_AXIS (tilted 30 deg)
defects.observed: 30 deg off (no sloped panel). L3.2.3.2 also fails: bezel face Z 13.0 to panel underside Z 16.0 gap 3.0 > 0.3

defects.where: lid.stl plate Z 16.0..18.1 over the viewport area X 7.75..72.25, Y 11..25 (module frame)
defects.what: No window: slices of lid.stl at Z 16, 17, 18 contain only four O2.4 lid screw holes at (-2.43,-2.43), (82.43,-2.43), (-2.43,38.43), (82.43,38.43).
defects.expected: through window in the panel, bbox 65.5..68.0 x 15.0..18.0, centred on VIEW_AXIS within 0.5
defects.observed: 0 windows (LCD display is covered by solid plate)

defects.where: layout.json unplaced[0] = rpi_pico2 "lcd1602_hd44780 is not a carrier: no relation places it yet"; base.stl has only 4 standoffs at the LCD holes (2.5,2.5), (77.5,2.5), (2.5,33.5), (77.5,33.5), OD 5.1, tops Z 0.0
defects.what: The Pico 2 is absent from the design: no Pico pose, no Pico standoffs, no stack clearance, no extract path.
defects.expected: 4 vertical standoffs at PICO_HOLE (47.0 x 11.4 pattern), d >= 1.0 to the LCD back zone, USB_AXIS +Y

defects.where: base.stl back wall (+Y, Y 36.6..39.0), ray at X 40 Z 8 hits 36.6 and 39.0 and the wall is solid over its whole face
defects.what: No USB opening; V-USB-PLUG (overmold 10.0 x 7.0 swept +Y) would penetrate the back wall. Plug is unplaced because the Pico is.
defects.expected: 1 opening, d >= 0.30 to V-USB-PLUG, opening <= 13.0 x 10.0

defects.what: Four bosses at all four corners where the brief fixes two screws at the rear corners; screw lengths undeclared so engagement cannot be verified.
defects.expected: boss count = 2 at the rear corners, engagement = screw length - panel thickness >= 5.0
defects.observed: count 4; pilot depth 5.1 with no declared length

defects.where: base.stl LCD standoffs (axes vertical), floor top Z -5.1
defects.what: LCD standoff axes are vertical because the LCD is not tilted; pilot depth 5.1 < engagement + 0.5 for any stock screw >= 8 and no screw length declared.
defects.expected: axis within 1.0 deg of VIEW_AXIS (tilted 30 deg); depth >= max(5.0, engagement+0.5)
defects.observed: axis 30 deg off the required VIEW_AXIS; depth 5.1

measured_and_passing: B∩L 0, one shell each, walls 2.4, floor 2.4, lid lip fit 0.25 engagement 2.4, lid holes O2.4 coaxial, LCD standoffs 4 at holes (O5.1, pilot O1.7, tops coplanar Z 0.0), LCD-to-wall 0.6, V-VIEW d 0.0 in the declared (flat) pose, size 90.5x46.5x24.1
note: claude-context MCP failed to connect (tools unavailable); fell back to direct reads/targeted tooling. Measured with trimesh/manifold3d on delivered STLs; reference volumes built from requirements.md values.
